notes.title: WHOLE NEW GAMEPLAY !!
notes.notes:
All traps/enemy warn you before to shot, and shot delays are longer, so to allow you to elaborate amazing speedrun strategies.
Also the level design has been polished in the whole game, now you'll feel way safer when rushing thru the levels !

The combo dash is now a Power Dash, that even allows you to destroy some bullets, small shot/traps etc, so to let you pass thru even more faster !!
Just try to spam dash button against floors, walls or ceilings and you'll see !!

notes.title: RUSH MODE AND NEW CYCLES
notes.notes:
Rush mode is now available,
You may be able to replay any level you already beaten,
With a timer to try to give your best and find speedrun strategies.
2 modes available : "normal" or "instadeath"

Gameplay : 
The gameplay has been enhanced since a few previous updates,
Now it's pretty stable thanks to the new cycle system,
Enemies and traps now only activate their pattern on screen,
So no more 'random-ish' different 'impossible' situations.
This way the experience is way better, especially for the rush mode.

Update 1.1.8.

notes.title: TRAPS SYNCHRONIZATION TO HERO
notes.notes:
Before, traps were all following a universal timer, it means if you reach some place with more of less 0.5second (or even 0.1 second) you were up to hit different situations (that fire ball already popped up, or still not you may not know how much time would it take it to pop up).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36989461/8136ffe03cb802f701400d6e5eeb25238d41c14a.png[/img]

Now, it's a bit like TRAPS ARE WAITING FOR YOU to activate, this way you can handle way MORE INTUITIVELY TIMINGS and try more speedrun stuffs, without landing on that tube popping at you its fireball, for exemple.

Don't worry, it does'nt mean the game will be all easy now, it's still hard, it's still Garlic, but way more suitable for rush plays, 

and by the way, RUSH MODE is coming out very soon too!
